buildCommand: mkdir -p public/data && cp index.html favicon.png apple-touch-icon.png og.jpg public/ && cp data/state.json public/data/

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: https:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https://raw.githubusercontent.com; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; object-src 'none'
